interface: open Python draft(state) through per-run confined IPC
metric: mean per-question latency ratio to a fresh counterbalanced ordinary AR calibration
U_justification: Zero is the mathematical lower bound of a positive latency ratio; no reliable attainable ceiling estimate is available before method research
precision: BF16; no reduced BF16 GEMM reduction; no TF32; automatic SDPA; no reduced math attention
text_proposal_behavior: Tokenizer encodes text; verify the first at most min(32,remaining_tokens) IDs
candidate_startup: included amortized over the evaluated questions
formal_model_optimization_gate: Validated anchors, full isolation and actual Harbor run required
baseline: independent ordinary AR policy, separate from same-batch calibration
change_reason: Native ordinary-AR repeat had apparent 14.8% speed gain against historical wall latency; same-batch paired calibration prevents GPU speed drift from becoming a method improvement
